description: evidentia runtime enforcement — turns three prose invariants into enforced behavior: (1) PreToolUse guard denies pipeworx-generic + D1/D2/D6 broken MCP tools with a redirect (least-privilege / G-WHITELIST + broken-tool avoidance); (2) PostToolUse reminds retrieve-don't-dump on large full-text output (evidence_index); (3) SessionStart preflight flags gated-connector problems, deriving the key map from fleet.lock.json (never hardcoded) and consulting the 24h-cached live fleet probe so a CONFIGURATION FAULT (401/403) is never mistaken for a legitimate key-absent degrade — silent when the fleet is healthy. All command hooks are deterministic and fail-open. Disable the guard with <project>/.claude/evidentia-guard.off; run the preflight offline with EVIDENTIA_PREFLIGHT_NO_PROBE=1.

hooks.statusMessage: evidentia: kanıt filosu preflight (kapılı connector + canlı prob)
